summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes `execFileSync('bun', [math_init.js])` to run a 727KB heavily obfuscated single-line bundle (math_init.js) that ships at the tarball root. The obfuscation uses a shuffled string/constant array, rotation function, and custom scrambled-alphabet decoder, with no readable URLs, imports, or business logic — everything is reconstructed at runtime. The payload has no relation to the package's stated purpose (a tslint folder-schema rule). The package.json `files` manifest declares only `["lib"]`, so both math_init.js and setup.mjs sit outside the author's declared publish surface while still being auto-executed on `npm install`. Executing the obfuscated blob under a fetched alternate runtime bypasses Node's module resolution and typical scanning, and is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time RCE shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
